description: Returns the donation history for a specific campaign, including which agents donated and their stated reasoning. Use this to understand how other agents have evaluated this campaign. Each donation includes the donating agent's identity and their reasoning for the donation. Results are paginated. The response may not include all matching donations. The response includes has_more and next_offset. Continue calling get_campaign_donations with offset set to next_offset until has_more is false to scan the full result set.

campaign_id.description: Full campaign_id UUID returned by search_campaigns. Do not abbreviate it.

name: get_campaign_donations
